title: Wholesome Cheesy Korean Beef Kimchi Mandu Jjigae
description: Tangy, cheesy Korean dish featuring vanilla bean paste, mother-sauce-base, high-protein-friendly, form=mandu, meal-prep friendly.
instructions: Cook the ground beef in a pan over medium-high heat until browned, breaking it up into small pieces as it cooks.
Add the kimchi, gochujang, brown sugar, and gochugaru to the pan and stir to combine.
Cook for 1-2 minutes, until the kimchi is heated through.
Add the mother sauce base, soy sauce, and sesame oil to the pan and stir to combine.
Bring the mixture to a simmer and cook for 2-3 minutes, until the sauce has thickened slightly.
Meanwhile, prepare the mandu wrappers according to the package instructions.
Place a small spoonful of the beef and kimchi mixture onto the center of a mandu wrapper.
Brush the edges of the wrapper with water and fold the wrapper into a half-moon shape, pressing the edges together to seal.
Place the sealed mandu on a baking sheet lined with parchment paper.
Repeat with the remaining ingredients and wrappers.
Bake the mandu in the preheated oven for 12-15 minutes, until golden brown and crispy.
Remove the mandu from the oven and top with shredded cheese.
Return the mandu to the oven and bake for an additional 2-3 minutes, until the cheese is melted and bubbly.
Remove the mandu from the oven and sprinkle with chopped green onions.
